provenance.source: NCERT Mathematics Class 8, Chapter 1 'Rational Numbers' — additive inverse. The four misconceptions are the ones this topic reliably produces: reciprocal confusion, the belief that an inverse must be negative, treating the three ways of writing a negative fraction as different numbers, and denying zero an inverse.
provenance.note: m1 (additive vs multiplicative inverse) is the one that matters. It is the single most common error on this topic and it is a genuine concept gap, not a slip — a student holding it will also get 'role of one' wrong later, which is why c8-math-ch1-t3 lists this topic as a prerequisite.

concepts.title: Additive inverse
concepts.statement: Kisi rational number $\frac{a}{b}$ ka additive inverse wo number hota hai jise usme jodne par 0 aaye. Yaani $\frac{a}{b} + \left(-\frac{a}{b}\right) = 0$. Ise us number ka 'negative' bhi kehte hain.
concepts.hook: Socho tumhare paas ₹50 hain aur tumne dost se ₹50 udhaar liye hain. Total kitna hua? Zero. Ye ₹50 aur -₹50 ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain — yahi additive inverse hai. Ab sawal: agar tumhare paas -₹50 hain, yaani ₹50 ka karza, to usko zero karne ke liye kya chahiye?

analogies.text: Lift me 3 floor upar jaana aur 3 floor neeche aana — wapas wahin.
Cricket me 4 run banaye phir 4 run ka penalty laga — net zero.
Temperature 5° badha phir 5° gira — wapas wahi temperature.

formulas.note: b ≠ 0. Yahi additive inverse ki definition hai.
Teeno ek hi number hain, sirf likhne ka tareeka alag.
Ye multiplicative inverse hai — additive se alag. Isse guna karne par 1 aata hai, jodne par nahi.

misconceptions.wrong_belief: Additive inverse matlab ulta kar do — $\frac{3}{5}$ ka inverse $\frac{5}{3}$.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Wo multiplicative inverse (reciprocal) hai, jisse guna karne par 1 aata hai. Additive inverse jodne par 0 deta hai. Check karke dekho: $\frac{3}{5} + \frac{5}{3}$ 0 nahi aata.
misconceptions.correction: Jodna hai to sign badlo. Guna hai to ulta karo.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{3}{5}$ me kya jodun ki 0 aaye? Aur kis se guna karun ki 1 aaye? Ye do alag sawal hain.

misconceptions.wrong_belief: Additive inverse hamesha negative hota hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Agar number khud negative hai to uska inverse positive hoga — kyunki 0 laane ke liye ulta sign chahiye, negative sign nahi.
misconceptions.correction: $-\frac{11}{4}$ ka additive inverse $+\frac{11}{4}$ hai. Sign ULTA hota hai, negative nahi.
misconceptions.probe: $-\frac{11}{4}$ me kya jodoge ki 0 mile? Wo positive hoga ya negative?

misconceptions.why_wrong: Teeno ka maan same hai, sirf likhne ka tareeka alag hai. Number line pe teeno ek hi jagah baithte hain.
misconceptions.correction: Sign numerator me ho, denominator me ho, ya poore fraction ke aage — value nahi badalti.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{3}{-5}$ ko standard form me likho. Ab batao ye $\frac{-3}{5}$ se alag hai ya wahi?

misconceptions.why_wrong: $0 + 0 = 0$, to 0 khud apna additive inverse hai. Definition kehti hai 'jise jodne par 0 aaye' — 0 ye shart poori karta hai.
misconceptions.correction: 0 hi ek aisa number hai jo apna additive inverse hai.
misconceptions.probe: 0 me kya jodein ki 0 aaye? Kya wo khud 0 ho sakta hai?

worked_examples.problem: $\frac{7}{9}$ ka additive inverse nikalo aur verify karo.

steps: Number already negative hai, to inverse positive hoga

worked_examples.problem: $\frac{5}{8}$ ka additive inverse aur multiplicative inverse — dono nikalo aur farak dikhao.
steps: Farak: ek jodne par 0 deta hai, doosra guna karne par 1

questions.solution: Sign badlo: $-\frac{5}{8}$. Check: $\frac{5}{8} + \left(-\frac{5}{8}\right) = 0$. $\frac{8}{5}$ multiplicative inverse hai — usse guna karne par 1 aata hai, jodne par 0 nahi.
Number pehle se negative hai, to uska inverse positive hoga: $\frac{13}{7}$. Check: $\frac{-13}{7} + \frac{13}{7} = 0$.

questions.stem: Agar $x$, $\frac{-4}{9}$ ka additive inverse hai, to $x + \frac{2}{9}$ ka maan kya hai? (dashamlav me do sthaan tak)
Sabit karo ki rational numbers me additive inverse unique hota hai — yaani ek number ke do alag additive inverse nahi ho sakte.

rubric: Maan liya ki $a$ ke do additive inverse hain, $y$ aur $z$
$y = y + 0 = y + (a + z) = (y + a) + z$ — associativity ka istemaal
$= 0 + z = z$, isliye $y = z$ aur inverse unique hai

questions.solution: Maan lo $a$ ke do additive inverse hain: $y$ aur $z$. To $a + y = 0$ aur $a + z = 0$. Ab $y = y + 0 = y + (a + z) = (y + a) + z = 0 + z = z$. Yahan zero ka additive identity hona aur addition ka associative hona — dono use hue. Chunki $y = z$, additive inverse unique hai.

options.text: $0$ ka additive inverse hota hi nahi

questions.solution: $0 + 0 = 0$, to 0 khud apna additive inverse hai. Ye ekmatra number hai jiske saath aisa hota hai.

questions.stem: In me se kaunsa $\frac{-3}{5}$ ke barabar NAHI hai?
questions.solution: $\frac{3}{-5}$, $-\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)$ aur $\frac{-6}{10}$ — teenon ka maan $\frac{-3}{5}$ hai. Sirf $\frac{3}{5}$ alag hai; wo to $\frac{-3}{5}$ ka additive inverse hai.

questions.stem: Kis number se $\frac{5}{8}$ ko guna karne par $1$ aata hai?
questions.solution: $\frac{5}{8} \times \frac{8}{5} = 1$ — ye multiplicative inverse hai. $-\frac{5}{8}$ additive inverse hai; usse jodne par 0 aata hai, guna karne par nahi. Ye sawal jaan-bujhkar ulta poochha gaya hai, taaki dono me farak saaf ho.

questions.stem: Neha ne likha: '$\frac{2}{7}$ ka additive inverse $\frac{7}{2}$ hai kyunki dono milke number ko cancel kar dete hain.' Uski galti kya hai?

options.text: $\frac{7}{2}$ multiplicative inverse hai — $\frac{2}{7} + \frac{7}{2}$ ka maan 0 nahi aata
Koi galti nahi, $\frac{7}{2}$ hi sahi hai
Galti sirf sign ki hai, jawab $-\frac{7}{2}$ hona chahiye
$\frac{2}{7}$ ka additive inverse hota hi nahi

questions.solution: 'Cancel' do tarah se hota hai aur dono alag hain. Jodne par 0 laane wala additive inverse hai — $-\frac{2}{7}$. Guna karne par 1 laane wala multiplicative inverse hai — $\frac{7}{2}$. Neha ne doosra wala pehle wale ki jagah likh diya.

questions.stem: $\frac{-7}{12}$ ka additive inverse $\frac{p}{12}$ hai. $p$ ka maan kya hoga?
questions.solution: $\frac{-7}{12}$ ka additive inverse $\frac{7}{12}$ hai, kyunki $\frac{-7}{12} + \frac{7}{12} = 0$. To $p = 7$.

questions.stem: $a = \frac{-5}{6}$ hai. $a$ ke additive inverse aur $a$ ke multiplicative inverse ko jodo. Jawab dashamlav me char sthaan tak likho.
questions.solution: Additive inverse: $\frac{5}{6}$. Multiplicative inverse: $\frac{-6}{5}$ (kyunki $\frac{-5}{6} \times \frac{-6}{5} = 1$). Jodo: $\frac{5}{6} + \frac{-6}{5} = \frac{25}{30} - \frac{36}{30} = \frac{-11}{30} \approx -0.3667$. Dhyan do — negative number ka multiplicative inverse bhi negative hota hai.

questions.stem: Ek doston ko samjhao ki additive inverse aur multiplicative inverse me kya farak hai. Ek udaharan dono ka do.

rubric: Additive inverse: jodne par 0 deta hai, sign badalkar milta hai
Multiplicative inverse: guna karne par 1 deta hai, ulta karke milta hai
Ek number pe dono dikhaye, jaise $\frac{3}{4}$ ka $-\frac{3}{4}$ aur $\frac{4}{3}$

questions.solution: Additive inverse wo hai jise jodne par 0 aaye — sign badal do. $\frac{3}{4}$ ka additive inverse $-\frac{3}{4}$ hai, kyunki $\frac{3}{4} + \left(-\frac{3}{4}\right) = 0$. Multiplicative inverse wo hai jisse guna karne par 1 aaye — ulta kar do. $\frac{3}{4}$ ka multiplicative inverse $\frac{4}{3}$ hai, kyunki $\frac{3}{4} \times \frac{4}{3} = 1$. Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: JODNA hai to SIGN badlo, GUNA hai to ULTA karo.
